subject: Unforeseen mechanical field condition: existing ductwork conflicting with the new

messages.text: Our crew hit the existing ductwork conflicting with the new structural beam at P-101 and need your call on the permanent fix. This is critical -- please treat this as a top priority. This condition will require a change order. No broader schedule impact is expected. A response Friday would be appreciated.
Reroute to clear the conflict at P-101 per the attached sketch; proceed once you've confirmed clearance. This condition will require a change order.
Photos show the existing ductwork conflicting with the new structural beam at P-101 goes further than we first thought -- does your direction still cover it? A response Friday would be appreciated.
